newsitem.title: USA: Female Health to launch female condom in Canada.
newsitem.headline: Female Health to launch female condom in Canada.

text.p: Female Health Co said on Tuesday it signed an agreement for Pharmascience, a privately-held Canadian health care products company, to distribute exclusively its Reality female condom in Canada.
Pharmascience, based in Montreal, plans to make the female condom available in Canadian pharmacies and clinics during the second quarter of 1997.

"We are pleased to enter into a partnership with Pharmascience as we continue to broaden our global expansion and move closer to our goal of making the female condom available throughout the world," said Dr. Mary Ann Leeper, Female Health president, in a statement.
Female Health has an exclusive distribution agreement for Taiwan and is currently in discussions with potential business partners in India, China and Russia and other countries.

The Reality female condom was approved for marketing in 1994. Female Health owns the worldwide rights to the female condom including patents which have been issued in the U.S., Japan, The European Union, China, Canada and Australia.
